intro: Since August 2021 Afghanistan has been ruled by the Taliban, who govern as the 'Islamic Emirate'.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The Taliban's supreme leader holds final authority, and there is no elected parliament. Laws are based on the Taliban's strict reading of Islamic law.

chapters.title: Recognition
text: In 2025 Russia became the first country to formally recognise the Taliban government; most countries have not.

keyTerms.meaning: A state ruled by an emir or religious leader.
